```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library('rlang')
library('ggplot2')
library('plyr')
library('plyr')
library('knitr')
```

## Data


```{r}
file= "LOCAL/EV/local_new.csv"
dt <- read.csv(file, sep = ",", header=TRUE ) 

colnames(dt) <- c("group", "precision", "recall", "f1score", "support", "model", "data") #, "AUC_VAL"
dt$f1score <- as.numeric(dt$f1score)
dt$data <- as.factor(dt$data)
dt$model <- as.factor(dt$model)
summary(dt)
```

```{r}
head(dt)
```


```{r}
dt2<-dt[dt$group=='macro avg', ]
head(dt2)
```

```{r}
dt2
```


```{r}
ggplot(dt2, aes(x=data, y=f1score, color=model, fill=model)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity", width=0.7, position=position_dodge(width=0.8))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), limits = c(0, 1)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.7, linetype="dashed", color = "orange")+
  theme_bw() +scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+#facet_wrap(vars(data), ncol = 4)+ 
   theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(), 
           axis.line = element_line(size=1, colour = "black"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", size=0),
           panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#d3d3d3"),
           panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
           panel.border = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(),
           plot.title = element_text(size = 14,  face = "bold"), #family = "Garamond",
           text=element_text(), #family="Garamond"
           axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, colour="black", size = 9),
           axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black", size = 9))  +
  labs(x = "Datasets", y = "F1-score" )
ggsave("local_descriptor.eps", dpi = 600)
```


```{r}
dt3<-ddply(dt, c("data", "model"), summarise, #
                 nobs = length(model), 
                 p = round(mean(precision, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
                 r = round(mean(recall, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
                 f1 = round(mean(f1score[group=='macro avg'], na.rm = TRUE), 3),
                 f1.sd = round(sd(f1score, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
                 )
head(dt3)
```

```{r}
ggplot(dt3, aes(x=data, y=f1, group=model, fill=model)) +
         geom_bar(stat="identity", position=position_dodge(width=0.9)) + 
         facet_grid(. ~ model) + 
         geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=f1 - f1.sd, ymax=f1 + f1.sd), #fill=model,
                       width=0.2, position=position_dodge(width=0.9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), limits = c(0, 1.03)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.7, linetype="dashed", color = "orange")+
  theme_bw() +scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+#facet_wrap(vars(data), ncol = 4)+
   theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(),
           axis.line = element_line(size=1, colour = "black"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", size=0),
           panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#d3d3d3"),
           panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
           panel.border = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(),
           plot.title = element_text(size = 14,  face = "bold"), #family = "Garamond",
           text=element_text(), #family="Garamond"
           axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, colour="black", size = 9),
           axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black", size = 9))  +
  labs(x = "Datasets", y = "F1-score" )
ggsave("local_descriptor_facet.eps", dpi = 600)
```
